tableDescription: Dimension table storing master company information for business entities.

columnDescriptions.company_id: Unique identifier for each company record.
columnDescriptions.unified_social_credit_code: China unified social credit identifier code.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when company record was created.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when company record was last modified.

tableDescription: Financial statement line item dimension table for balance sheet, income, and cash flow items.

columnDescriptions.item_id: Unique identifier for each financial line item.
columnDescriptions.statement_type: Type of financial statement: balance sheet, income, or cash flow.
columnDescriptions.item_side: Statement section: assets, liabilities/equity, income, or cash flow.
columnDescriptions.item_name: Name of the financial line item as displayed.
columnDescriptions.row_no: Original line number from the source financial statement.
columnDescriptions.display_order: Sequential ordering for presenting items in reports.
columnDescriptions.is_total: Flag indicating whether the item is a total or subtotal.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was initially created.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

tableDescription: Stores company financial statement amounts across periods, items, and reporting types from Excel sources.

columnDescriptions.amount_id: Unique identifier for each financial amount record
columnDescriptions.company_id: Foreign key referencing the reporting company dimension
columnDescriptions.item_id: Foreign key referencing the financial statement line item dimension
columnDescriptions.report_period: Reporting period in YYYYMM format, such as 202605
columnDescriptions.report_date: Exact calendar date of the financial report
columnDescriptions.fiscal_year: Fiscal year component extracted from the reporting period
columnDescriptions.fiscal_month: Fiscal month component extracted from the reporting period
columnDescriptions.statement_type: Type of financial statement: balance sheet, income, or cash flow
columnDescriptions.amount_type: Nature of the figure: balance, monthly, quarterly, or year-to-date
columnDescriptions.quarter_no: Quarter number of the period; zero indicates non-quarterly data
columnDescriptions.amount: Monetary value in original currency; null when source cell is empty
columnDescriptions.currency: Currency code of the recorded monetary amount
columnDescriptions.source_file_name: Original Excel file name used for data lineage tracing
columnDescriptions.source_sheet_name: Original Excel worksheet name used for data lineage tracing
columnDescriptions.source_cell: Original Excel cell coordinate used for data lineage tracing
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first inserted
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when the record was last modified

tableDescription: Cash flow statement detail by line item, period, and reporting company.

columnDescriptions.展示顺序: Display order following original statement layout
columnDescriptions.行次: Original line number from the statement

tableDescription: Detailed balance sheet line items by company and reporting period for financial analysis.

columnDescriptions.报表日期: Exact date of the financial statement
columnDescriptions.项目归属: Line item category: assets, liabilities, income, or cash flow
columnDescriptions.展示顺序: Display order following original statement row sequence
columnDescriptions.行次: Original row number from the source financial report
columnDescriptions.项目名称: Name of the financial statement line item
columnDescriptions.期末余额: Balance amount at the end of the reporting period
columnDescriptions.年初余额: Balance amount at the beginning of the reporting year

tableDescription: Stores detailed income statement line items for companies with monthly and year-to-date amounts.

columnDescriptions.公司名称: Name of the company reporting financials.
columnDescriptions.报表日期: Exact date of the financial statement.
columnDescriptions.展示顺序: Display order following the original report sequence.
columnDescriptions.行次: Original line number from the source report.
columnDescriptions.项目名称: Name of the financial statement line item.
columnDescriptions.本月金额: Monetary amount for the current month.

tableDescription: Superstore retail order line items with customer, product, geographic, financial, and ingestion audit fields.

columnDescriptions.row_id: Surrogate primary key identifying each order line.
columnDescriptions.order_id: Business identifier grouping line items under one customer order.
columnDescriptions.order_date: Calendar date when the customer placed the order.
columnDescriptions.ship_date: Calendar date when the order line was shipped.
columnDescriptions.ship_mode: Shipping service level chosen for delivery.
columnDescriptions.customer_id: Unique identifier assigned to the purchasing customer.
columnDescriptions.customer_name: Full name of the customer who placed the order.
columnDescriptions.segment: Market segment classification of the customer.
columnDescriptions.city: Destination city for the shipped order.
columnDescriptions.province: Destination province or autonomous region for shipment.
columnDescriptions.country_region: Country where the customer is located.
columnDescriptions.region: Macro geographic region grouping provinces within China.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Unique identifier of the purchased product.
columnDescriptions.sub_category: Detailed product subcategory beneath the category.
columnDescriptions.product_name: Full descriptive name of the purchased product.
columnDescriptions.sales: Revenue amount generated by the order line.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Number of units sold on the order line.
columnDescriptions.discount: Discount rate applied to the order line.
columnDescriptions.profit: Net profit earned on the order line after discount.
columnDescriptions.postal_code: Postal code of the customer shipping address.
columnDescriptions.source_system: Originating system that supplied the record.
columnDescriptions.source_file: Path of the source file the record was extracted from.
columnDescriptions.source_sheet: Worksheet name within the source file containing the data.
columnDescriptions.source_row_number: Row number of the record within the source worksheet.
columnDescriptions.batch_id: Identifier of the ingestion batch that loaded the record.
columnDescriptions.row_hash: SHA-256 hash of business fields for change detection.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag indicating whether the record is active.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Timestamp when the record was first written to the warehouse.
columnDescriptions.updated_at: Timestamp when the record was last modified in the warehouse.
